guide:
You are grading a question-answering benchmark. Judge each item on its own.

For an "answer" item: is the model answer the same answer as any gold answer?
Count it correct when it names the same entity, value or yes/no decision, even
with different wording, extra title words, or a short explanation. Count it
wrong when it is a different entity, hedges between options, says it cannot
answer, or adds a claim that contradicts the gold answer.

For an "evidence" item: list the indexes of the gold sentences whose fact is
stated by the evidence text. A fact is stated when a reader of the evidence
alone would learn it (same entity, same claim, same date or number when the
sentence has one). Be strict: topic overlap or a generic description of the
same subject is not enough. Return an empty list when none.

Write verdicts.json as a JSON array with one object per item, in any order:
{"id": "...", "correct": true}             for answer items
{"id": "...", "supported": [0, 2]}          for evidence items
Use only ids from items.json and do not skip any item.

answers.question: After Sporting News reported on Alejandro Mata's successful 31-yard field goal for Colorado on October 28, 2023, did the same news source report a successful or unsuccessful field goal attempt by Jayden Fielding in a later article?

Between the TechCrunch report on Sam Bankman-Fried published on October 2, 2023, and the TechCrunch report on Sam Bankman-Fried published on October 7, 2023, was there consistency in the portrayal of Sam Bankman-Fried's alleged actions?

Does 'The Guardian' article describe 'the match' as a contest of disparity between a wealthy team and a young team, while the 'Sporting News' article focuses on 'Shohei Ohtani's' decision on team selection without mentioning any disparity?

Between the TechCrunch report on Sam Bankman-Fried's trial and the subsequent report by the same source on the prosecution's allegations against him, was there inconsistency in the portrayal of the charges he is facing?

After TechCrunch reported on Google's annual hardware event on October 7, 2023, and then on Google's expenditure to be the default search engine on various platforms on November 13, 2023, did TechCrunch's subsequent report on December 15, 2023, regarding a class action antitrust suit against Google indicate a consistent or inconsistent portrayal of Google's business practices?

After Sporting News reported on Johnny Cardoso's inclusion in the USMNT squad post-injury on October 4, 2023, and CBSSports.com announced De'Von Achane's move to Injured Reserve on October 12, 2023, which player's status changed between the two reports, Johnny Cardoso or De'Von Achane?

Does the TechCrunch article suggest a different perception of Sam Bankman-Fried's character compared to the portrayal by The Verge, with TechCrunch not referring to him as the white horse of crypto, while The Verge discusses his instructions on withdrawal permissions relative to trading revenue?
